title: Existence of determinant isomorphism
statement: the determinant isomorphism exists and satisfies the wedge formula for arbitrary quotient lifts.

proof.text: Apply the adopted determinant_wedgeMorphism_exists to obtain a canonical exteriorPower morphism psi and its formula on tensors of wedges.

Let eA be the tensor of the outside exteriorSheafPowerIso comparisons and eB the middle comparison. Define phi=eA.hom ≫ psi ≫ eB.inv. Derive the hom wedge equation from exteriorSheafPowerIso_inv_wedge and the inverse-hom identity. tensorHom_app_tmulSection, these hom equations, the formula for psi and the inverse wedge equation give the required legacy formula hphi. All ranks, including zero, and all opens, including the empty open, are covered.
Take the splitting cover from exists_openCover_split_shortExact. For each point choose a member containing it, using the supremum equality with the top open.

On each splitting-cover member apply the adopted determinant_wedgeMorphism_bijective_of_split to psi and its canonical wedge formula. Hom.isIso_of_forall_bijective_app gives IsIso psi globally. The comparison identities give eA.hom ≫ psi ≫ eB.inv = phi, hence IsIso phi by composition of isomorphisms.
Take the inverse of asIso phi for e. Its inverse is definitionally phi, so the required formula is hphi unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem determinant_shortExact_exists {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules)
    (hS : S.ShortExact) (r₁ r₂ r₃ : ℕ) (hr : r₂ = r₁ + r₃)
    [S.X₁.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₁] [S.X₂.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₂]
    [S.X₃.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank r₃] :
    ∃ e : exteriorSheaf S.X₂ r₂ ≅ exteriorSheaf S.X₁ r₁ ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ r₃,
      ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r₁ → S.X₁.val.obj (op U))
        (b : Fin r₃ → S.X₃.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin r₃ → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)),
        (∀ i, S.g.val.app (op U) (c i) = b i) →
        e.inv.val.app (op U)
          (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection S.X₁ r₁ U a)
            (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ r₃ U b)) =
          exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ r₂ U
            (fun i ↦ Fin.append (fun j ↦ S.f.val.app (op U) (a j)) c (Fin.cast hr i))
